candidates.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Unveil RTX Spark AI Superchip for PCs
candidates.description: NVIDIA and Microsoft introduced 'RTX Spark,' a new AI superchip for Windows PCs capable of 1 petaflop of AI performance. The chip is designed to enable local, personal AI agents, shifting the paradigm of AI interaction on personal devices.

candidates.title: US DOD and NSA Launch Joint Task Force to Integrate Frontier AI Models into Military Operations
candidates.description: The US Department of Defense (DOD) and National Security Agency (NSA) announced the formation of a joint task force to accelerate the integration of cutting-edge AI models into military and defense operations, signaling a deepened commitment to AI in national security.

candidates.title: Groq Reportedly Raises $650 Million to Expand AI Inference Cloud Services
candidates.description: Groq, a company specializing in AI inference hardware and cloud services, reportedly secured $650 million in funding to scale its operations and expand its offerings in the rapidly growing market for AI inference at scale.
